title: Research: exact L248/L253 temporal gauge composition (no new kappa)
body:
## Status

Finite complex-word composition and fixed-pair optimum; no new κ or selected-supplier adoption.

## Result

This package composes the pinned PR1353 L248 absolute temporal gauge with the PR1350 L253 time-varying offset over L253's retained static gauge, using the common PR1263 frozen word. The schedule IDs use different streams, so the verifier maps each schedule onto the ordered source ADD sequence before comparison. The L248 and L253 incidence sets contain 71 and 96 ADDs respectively and are disjoint in both orientations.

Since no ADD price term depends on both changing coordinates, the exact objectives separate. The two pinned one-coordinate minima therefore give the global optimum for this fixed pair with every other PR1263 gauge held fixed. Reconstructing both single-coordinate words matches their recorded invoices; the composed word then passes the exact 712-column endpoint and complete lowerer invoice:

- Forward: 135,730 complex primitives, 272 below the PR1263 baseline.
- Backward: 135,746 complex primitives, 272 below the PR1263 baseline.
- Both preserve the paid recursive profile and inherited 192-bit local charge; all dirty helpers and center columns restore/clear.

This is not a search over other pairs or the full gauge vector. It does not change the selected record or κ.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-temporal-gauge-pair-seed26/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-temporal-gauge-pair-seed26/test_package.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-temporal-gauge-pair-seed26 --check-only
```

Expected verifier output:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_L248_L253_TEMPORAL_COMPOSITION
forward shared_add_ids 0 complex_primitives 135730 columns 712 no_new_kappa
backward shared_add_ids 0 complex_primitives 135746 columns 712 no_new_kappa
```

All three package checks passed on CPython 3.14.7; six focused tests pass. The pinned PR1350 and PR1353 verifiers were also rerun successfully. Python 3.12 is not installed locally, so the registered Python 3.12 replay was not run.

## Pins, overlap, and limits

- Assignment: complex supplier, OS seed 26.
- Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`.
- Frozen PR1263 head: `5fbaca13028846bddbb001e8e07addc2ab8e5816`.
- Temporal predecessors: PR1350 head `64b8a55c6933ffb6d9e30fa19f85d05b572d4aa5`; PR1353 head `efc6bfc3302a966ac0e1f5f4656e94b4cabeb9ca`.
- The latest overlap refresh found PR1369's zero-static single-coordinate census; its head `f28e1c460cd910886f9b06835abd6b1c96d2992f` explicitly does not compose schedules. This contribution composes the distinct nonzero-static L248/L253 pair. It also differs from PR1350's deferred neighboring L253/L254 question.
- Exact base and predecessor source hashes are in `SOURCES.json`; the one-coordinate optimum proofs remain inherited from the pinned open PR1350 and PR1353 packages.

Native supplier/controller admission, whole-call hosting, all-size compilation, analytic transfer, and the multiplication theorem remain outside this finite scalar composition. No new κ is claimed.
